newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU envoy to visit Great Lakes region.
newsitem.headline: EU envoy to visit Great Lakes region.

text.p: The European Union's special envoy to the African Great Lakes leaves Brussels on Wednesday for a three-week visit to the region, the Dutch/EU presidency said.

Aldo Ajello will meet government leaders from Rwanda, Uganda, Burundi, Zaire and Tanzania to discuss the crisis in east Zaire and the worsening situation in Burundi, the Dutch foreign ministry said in a statement.

The return of over one million refugees to Rwanda will also be discussed, and Ajello will meet former Tanzanian president Julius Nyerere for talks on Burundi where Tutsi and Hutu factions are in conflict.

Ajello will also sound out opinion from regional leaders about setting up a Conference on Peace, Security and Stability under the auspices of the United Nations and the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).

The EU special envoy is also looking forward to closer cooperation with Mohamed Sahnoun, the Algerian diplomat named last week as the joint U.N./OAU representative for the Great Lakes, the statement said.
